BiblicalUsage: Charabown is parching heat, drought, and it appears once: day and night thy hand was heavy upon me, and my moisture is turned into the drought of summer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is the most honest description of unconfessed sin in the Bible: it dries a man out from the inside.
